blocks.prompt: 8 Two sounds have intensities \(I_1\) and \(I_2\) such that \(L_1 = 85\) dB and \(L_2 = 65\) dB. Find the ratio \(\frac{I_1}{I_2}\), where \(I_0 = 10^{-12}\ \text{W/m}^2\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh do awaazon ke muqable ka sawal hai, bilkul kitab ke Example 26 jaisa.
Diya kya hai? Pehli awaaz ka level \(L_1 = 85\) dB, doosri ka \(L_2 = 65\) dB, aur \(I_0 = 10^{-12}\).
Find kya karna hai? Sirf ratio \(\frac{I_1}{I_2}\), dono intensities alag alag nahi.
Rule kaunsa? Decibel formula har awaaz ke liye, phir exponential form, aur divide karne par \(I_0\) cancel.
Plan: do equations, dono ko 10 se divide, exponential form, aur aakhir mein ek ko doosri se divide.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(L_1 = 85\) dB, \(L_2 = 65\) dB, \(I_0 = 10^{-12}\ \text{W/m}^2\).
Maloom karna: \(\frac{I_1}{I_2}\).
Tareeqa: Example 26 wala: har awaaz ki equation, exponential form, aur division.

Pehli awaaz ka formula
\[85 = 10\log\left(\dfrac{I_1}{I_0}\right)\]
\[8.5 = \log\left(\dfrac{I_1}{I_0}\right)\]
Kyun: values rakhin aur 10 se divide kiya. 8.5 jaisa decimal aana bilkul theek hai.

Doosri awaaz ka formula
\[65 = 10\log\left(\dfrac{I_2}{I_0}\right)\]
\[6.5 = \log\left(\dfrac{I_2}{I_0}\right)\]
Kyun: wohi qadam doosri awaaz ke liye.

Exponential form
\[\dfrac{I_1}{I_0} = 10^{8.5}\]
\[\dfrac{I_2}{I_0} = 10^{6.5}\]
Kyun: \(\log x = y\) ka matlab \(x = 10^{y}\).

Dono equations ko divide karein
\[\dfrac{I_1}{I_2} = \dfrac{10^{8.5}}{10^{6.5}}\]
\[= 10^{8.5-6.5} = 10^{2}\]
\[= 100\]
Kyun: \(\frac{I_1/I_0}{I_2/I_0}\) mein \(I_0\) upar neeche se cancel ho jata hai. Powers divide hon to exponents minus: \(8.5 - 6.5 = 2\).
Dhyan dein: \(10^{8.5}\) ko alag se calculate karne ki zaroorat nahi; exponents ka farq hi kaafi hai.

Tasdeeq
\[L_1 - L_2 = 10\log\left(\dfrac{I_1}{I_2}\right)\]
\[= 10\log 100 = 20\ \text{dB} \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: 85 aur 65 mein waqai 20 dB ka farq hai. Yaad rakhiye: har 10 dB par 10 guna, to 20 dB par \(10 \times 10 = 100\) guna.
blocks.final_answer: \(\frac{I_1}{I_2} = 100\); pehli awaaz doosri se 100 guna intense hai.
